description:
Record money received against threads and compare billed with received; stored in threads/<Kind>/<Name>/payments.md.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD AMOUNT [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE...] — record a receipt
  list [THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--as-of DATE] [--pdf PATH] [--json] — billed vs received by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount AMOUNT] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE...] — change fields of a payment
  rm ID -y — permanently delete a payment

Args:
  THREAD  thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
  AMOUNT  positive number, e.g. 15000.00; always give it
  ID  8-char payment id from payments list

Flags:
  log:
    -c, --currency CODE  ISO code; default the thread's currency
    -d, --date YYYY-MM-DD  date received; default today
    -t, --time HH:MM  default now
    -a, --account TEXT  account it landed in
    -n, --note TEXT...  free text; consumes all following words
  statement:
    --thread THREAD  one thread only
    --as-of YYYY-MM-DD  statement date; drives aging; default today
    --pdf PATH  render a PDF to PATH; requires --thread
  edit:
    --amount N; -c CODE; -d YYYY-MM-DD; -t HH:MM; -a TEXT; -n TEXT...  new values
  list, statement, show:
    --since / --until YYYY-MM-DD; --json
  rm:
    -y, --yes  required to confirm

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "15000.00", "-d", "2026-10-01", "-a", "Business cheque"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--since", "2026-01-01"]
  ["edit", "9f8e7d6c", "--amount", "14500.00"]

Notes:
  Put -n last; it consumes every following argument.
  log also queues a REF: in buffer.md, filed into the thread's log for the date received on buffer flush.
  Exit 1: amount missing, invalid or not positive; --pdf without --thread; nothing to state for the thread.
